checks: Opening ordinary View never fetches the original.
Static View does not load editor, renderer, or draft modules.
Native overlay makes the background inert.
Related characters render below the media preview as a non-disclosure section.
The single additional-instructions field appends plain intent to the read-only base Prompt.
The detail follows a site-language change while preserving additional text and leaving original Artwork facts unchanged.
Static Export downloads the original PNG byte-for-byte after external instructions change.
Clipboard denial and popup blocking retain the full unified Prompt and a manual link.
A late prior-site-language callback cannot overwrite the current Prompt or the additional instructions.
A rejected stale site-language request cannot disable the latest successful Prompt actions.
A static artwork preview failure does not block its independent Prompt.
Preview failure retains the registered cover.
404, wrong original hash, and decode failure reject without fake download success.
The explicitly approved Template automatically loads its editor in production when its bound Artwork opens.
Copy, ChatGPT, and Export remain disabled while rendering even when extra instructions change; they recover with the successful matching revision.
A failed latest render keeps all three primary actions disabled and does not combine new instructions with stale pixels.
Explicit Retry restores the current canvas and only then re-enables the unified Prompt and PNG actions.
Variant failure retains current content; successful preview and Prompt commit once with the version callback.
A delayed static Export stays byte-identical to the clicked Artwork after switching the visible character.
The approved release exposes no pending candidate in the public detail flow.
Overlay restores invoking focus and background after closure.
